// about

About Me

I'm a backend-focused developer from Gobichettipalayam who enjoys turning real problems into working software. I've built a platform used daily by 10 students, a MySQL-backed booking system with an 8+ table schema, and a Flutter weather app covering all of Tamil Nadu.

Outside code, I'm a competitive chess player and a part-time chess coach for children, which keeps my patience, communication and pattern-recognition sharp. I'm an analytical, quick learner with an interest in competitive programming, and I enjoy team-based projects.

🚚

Mr Driving TN: 3D Tamil Nadu Driving Simulator

JavaScriptThree.jsReactOpenStreetMapNode.jsVercel
  • Browser-based 3D driving game set in Erode district (Gobichettipalayam, Sathyamangalam, Chennimalai), built from OpenStreetMap roads, water, forest and elevation data, with Tamil and English signboards.
  • Drive a Honda Acty mini-truck with cab, chase and far camera views, fuel and body-damage meters, indicators, horn, rain and sunlight settings; touch steering wheel and pedals on phones plus keyboard controls.
  • Pick-up and delivery jobs with fares, a live minimap with route and ETA, petrol-bunk refuelling, and traffic of autos, buses, lorries, bikes and ambulances.
  • Optimised glTF vehicle models and textures with a Node build pipeline; live on Vercel.
Play the game
🌾

Pattikkaadu: Land Marketplace for Tamil Nadu

ReactTypeScriptTailwind CSSGoogle Apps ScriptCapacitorVercel
  • Bilingual (Tamil + English) marketplace where sellers list farmland and plots, and buyers browse by land type, location and "suitable for" use such as paddy, coconut or building a home.
  • Serverless backend on Google Apps Script with Google Sheets and Drive as the database and image store; email OTP sign-up, salted password hashes and login lockout after repeated failures.
  • Admin panel for approving listings, managing land types and releasing owner contacts only after approval; in-app and Android push notifications for listings, inquiries and status changes.
  • Installable as a PWA and packaged as an Android app with Capacitor; live on Vercel.
Live demo
🎪

Event Tamizha: Event Booking App

Web AppTamil + English3D PreviewNetlify
  • Bilingual Tamil and English app to book pandal, lighting decoration, rental products and sound service in one place.
  • Interactive 3D pandal preview with night mode and spin, size presets from Small to Grand, and length and breadth sliders that show the area and how many guests fit.
  • Cart, My Bookings and get-an-estimate flow, with simple mobile number and password sign-in.

Daily Chess Puzzle Platform

JavaScriptSupabasePostgresNetlify
  • Built for 10 chess-coaching students: 3 fresh puzzles uploaded every day, name-only login, and click-to-move play under a countdown timer.
  • Admin dashboard tracks puzzle uploads, solver completion times and hint usage, with point deductions to encourage independent solving.
  • Points-and-speed leaderboard to motivate daily practice, backed by Supabase (Postgres + Auth) and deployed on Netlify.

Real-Time Weather Forecasting App

FlutterDartOpenWeatherMap APIProvider
  • Cross-platform Flutter app delivering instant, location-aware forecasts covering all of Tamil Nadu, with no manual city search and Provider-based state management.
  • Automated location detection via GPS and live OpenWeatherMap data, surfacing temperature, humidity and 5-day forecasts in real time.
  • Clean Material Design UI with full dark/light mode support.
